c4_disclosure.statement: Before the freeze, exploratory values of the primary contrast theta_P (equal-weight mean over cells of W_P - W_RANDOM) were computed and seen by the M2 session and are in the owner-facing M2 records. The owner chose T = 40 and the shared tie key with these values available. All are exploratory, on different root seeds from the confirmatory one, with 3 to 5 instances per cell; none tests a hypothesis. Values are point estimates with 95% stratified bootstrap CIs.
